gloss: to be mysterious; to be enigmatic; to seem puzzling

definitions.gloss: to be mysterious; to be enigmatic; to seem puzzling
definitions.explanation: to have a mysterious or puzzling quality; to give an air of mystery

examples.japanese: {謎|なぞ}めいた{笑|え}みを{浮|う}かべた。
{彼|かれ}の{言葉|ことば}は{謎|なぞ}めいていた。
その{古|ふる}い{屋敷|やしき}には{謎|なぞ}めいた{雰囲気|ふんいき}が{漂|ただよ}っていた。
examples.english: An air of mystery hung about the old mansion.

examples.japanese: {事件|じけん}は{謎|なぞ}めいたまま{未解決|みかいけつ}となった。
examples.english: The case remained mysterious and unsolved.

notes:
A godan verb formed with the suffix めく (to have the appearance of, to seem like), attached to {謎|なぞ} (riddle, mystery). Almost always used in the て-form ({謎|なぞ}めいて) or た-form ({謎|なぞ}めいた) as a modifier.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {謎|なぞ}めいた{笑|え}み: an enigmatic smile
- {謎|なぞ}めいた{雰囲気|ふんいき}: a mysterious atmosphere
- {謎|なぞ}めいた{言葉|ことば}: cryptic words
- {謎|なぞ}めいた{人物|じんぶつ}: a mysterious figure

GRAMMAR:
The suffix めく attaches to nouns to create godan verbs meaning "to have the quality of ~." Other examples include {春|はる}めく (to become spring-like), {色|いろ}めく (to become excited/colorful), and {時|とき}めく (to feel a thrill).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {不思議|ふしぎ}な: mysterious or strange; a more common, general-purpose adjective
- {神秘的|しんぴてき}な: mystical, spiritual; carries a more sacred or awe-inspiring nuance than {謎|なぞ}めく

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {謎|なぞ}めいていませんでした
